name: lanshu-awesome-ai-video-kit
title_zh: 411 条提示词按镜头编号排好，拍企业片直接抄
tagline_zh: 从甲方 brief 到交付片，15 个模型选型表 + 7 个 Claude Skill 替你扛。不是教程合集。
tagline_en: From client brief to final cut: 15 model picks + 7 Claude Skills. Built from real agency projects, not a tutorial.
desc_en: 做企业 AI 视频项目逼出来的工具包 · 411 prompt · 15 模型 · 7 Claude Skill · 14 篇方法论
why_zh: 按真实项目流程组织，不是收藏夹。每条 prompt 都标了适用模型和失败案例，抄的时候知道哪步会翻车。
why_en: Organized by actual production workflow, not bookmarks. Each prompt names its model and known failure modes, so you know where.
limit_zh: 只覆盖企业宣传片/产品视频的文案与分镜环节，不含剪辑软件操作。需要自备 Claude 账号。
limit_en: Covers scripting & storyboarding for corporate/product videos only—no editing software guidance. Needs a Claude account. Prompts are text assets.

install.note: clone 下来，挑你要的那件复制进 ~/.claude/skills/。这是一个合集，没有「装它」这个动作。

title_en: 411 prompts sorted by shot number for corporate video shoots
